title: STMutants: A Mutation Testing Dataset for Structured Text Programs in Industrial Automation
datasets: STMutants Figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31724761.v3: 110 generated first-order mutant files across 11 IEC 61131-3 Structured Text programs, 108 retained/test-observable. Programs come from OSCAT basic library and sources cited by Koziolek et al. This paper does not use Defects4J experimentally; it mentions Defects4J only in related work.
models: GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 hosted APIs.
artifact_url: Dataset: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.31724761.v3 (public Figshare record). Compiler dependency: https://github.com/nucleron/matiec (upstream MATIEC, not this paper’s implementation).
license: Manuscript and Figshare dataset CC BY 4.0; no software license
input_setting: For each ST program, prompt an LLM once to produce test vectors and expected outputs; substitute each mutant into a harness while reusing the same generated tests; compare outputs. This is synthetic mutation testing for IEC 61131-3 PLC programs, not historical bug reproduction or Java/Python issue-level testing.
reproduction_grade: D (dataset public only; experiment source/harness and exact model configs absent)
concept_hook: Low direct fit; adjacent mutation-testing benchmark for industrial PLC Structured Text, not historical bug/root-cause testing.
limitation: Figshare archive contains mutant files only; no experiment code/harness; hosted model calls required; Defects4J only related work.
